checkInText: Kal squats badhaye the, aaj knee thoda swollen aur stairs pe khichav
explanation: Kal aapne squats badhaye the aur aaj swelling kal se zyada hai, isliye aaj lighter day rakhte hain: heel slides, quad sets, straight-leg raises aur ice + elevation, bodyweight squats aur bike aaj nahi karni. Ye baat apne physio ko zaroor bata dena.
